items.claim: The serves link to o4 is unjustified by its observable. Building a plugin registry and a class decorator that adds a method does not require attribute tagging.
items.fix: Remove pd-attribute-tagging's serves link to o4 and recompute its tier.

items.claim: The serves link to o4 is unjustified by its observable. Neither building the registry nor adding a method with a class decorator requires caching.
items.fix: Remove pd-lru-cache's serves link to o4 and recompute its tier.

items.claim: kc-factory-missing-parens says the name necessarily becomes bound to the inner decorator. With the factory-time validation required by kc-retry-validate-times, passing the function as times instead raises TypeError at times < 1.
items.fix: Replace kc-factory-missing-parens with: "For a factory expecting configuration, @retry passes the decorated function as its first argument instead. This can raise during factory execution; if the factory accepts that argument and returns its inner decorator, that inner decorator becomes the decorated name's value."

items.claim: kc-property-setter says the setter method "must reuse the name x." A different name is valid, but binds the new property to that name and leaves x unchanged.
items.fix: Replace kc-property-setter with: "@x.setter creates a new property retaining the existing getter and deleter and using the decorated function as its setter. Name the decorated function x to replace x; a different name binds the new property there instead."
